jobs.title: Principle Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Job ID: 9576

Date Posted:
October 1, 2026

The Space Dynamics Laboratory’s (SDL) Strategic & Military Space Division is seeking a highly accomplished Mission Engineer – Missile Defense Systems & Technology to provide senior technical leadership in the development, integration, analysis, test, and advancement of complex missile defense capabilities.

The Mission Engineer will serve as a recognized technical authority supporting missile defense programs and will work across engineering disciplines to solve complex system-of-systems challenges involving command and control, sensors, weapons, communications, networks, software, modeling and simulation, and operational mission systems.

This position requires an individual who can operate effectively at both the detailed technical level and the enterprise level, translating complex engineering and analytical findings into actionable recommendations for program leadership, government customers, and senior decision-makers.

The ideal candidate has extensive experience supporting the Missile Defense Agency (MDA), Department of Defense missile defense programs, or comparable complex defense systems and has demonstrated the ability to lead multidisciplinary technical efforts from requirements definition and architecture through integration, test, fielding, and operational support.

The Strategic & Military Space Division delivers advanced satellite and sensor systems that support the Department of Defense and the Intelligence Community. Our division is a key component of national security, providing technological solutions and expert mission support. Become part of a team dedicated to making a tangible contribution to our nation’s defense capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

Serves as a senior technical authority for missile defense technology, system architecture, integration, analysis, and engineering activities
Provides technical leadership across the full system development lifecycle, including concept development, requirements, architecture, design, integration, verification, validation, test, fielding, and operational assessment
Supports and advises the C2BMC-G Chief Engineer, Architect, Technical Advisor, and GAMMA lead on development of a global node for C2BMC
Creates strategy and vision, and leads teams to meet objectives directing and performing evaluation and assessments for integration of complex systems
Works with internal and external stakeholders in all phases of the engineering process: requirements definition and management, design, integration, test, and operations
Develops inputs to and evaluate contractor program baseline planning and execution
Perform technical oversight of classified project development, risk assessments, and contractor performance against requirements
Independently evaluates contractor technical reports and analyses
Reviews, comments, and prepares technical responses for the Government program office on contractor proposals
Performs independent evaluation and assessment in support of DCC and USSPACECOM
Assesses emerging technologies and recommend technical approaches for improving missile defense performance, resilience, interoperability, and mission effectiveness
Mentors’ engineers and technical leads and helps establish engineering methodologies, standards, and best practices across the organization

Required Qualifications

Minimum 20 years’ experience of engineering, analysis, test, or technical leadership experience supporting complex aerospace, missile defense, space, or national security systems
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, both verbal and written, with a wide range of internal and external customers
Strong organizational skills, quick learner, and demonstrated problem solver
Able to apply knowledge to complex, practical situations
Master’s degree or equivalent in engineering or computer science
Direct experience supporting the Missile Defense Agency (MDA) or integrated air and missile defense missions
Deep knowledge of C2BMC system including supported Combatant Commands, sensor utilization, algorithms to support tracking, battle management & sensor resource management
Experience with missile defense, integrated air and missile defense, command-and-control systems, weapon systems, space systems, or comparable complex DoW mission systems
Able to work independently and as part of a team
Must be a US citizen and be able to obtain a US Government security clearance
Active DoW Top Secret Security Clearance
Eligible for SSBI, SCI, SI/TK
Some travel is required

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with mission functional framework and operations concept development
Experience in designing test campaigns for systems verification
Experience with multi-domain application of Command and Control
Experience with missile defense flight testing, ground testing, or operational assessment
Experience with Failure Review Boards, root-cause investigations, anomaly resolution, or mission-critical technical response
Experience directing or providing technical oversight of prime contractors, subcontractors, FFRDCs, UARCs, government laboratories, or other engineering organizations
Demonstrated record of developing innovative engineering or analytical methodologies that significantly improve technical performance, test effectiveness, or organizational decision-making

Salary Range

$170,000 - $210,000
Salary commensurate on education and relevant experience

This range serves as a general guideline and may vary based on factors such as role, level, location, market conditions, and individual qualifications, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. The range displayed in the job advertisement reflects the minimum and maximum target salaries across all US locations. Specific salary details for a candidate’s preferred location can be provided by the recruiter or HR manager during the hiring process.

Why Join SDL?

SDL offers competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. Visit our Benefits Page to learn more about what we offer.

SDL delivers advanced multi-domain solutions to protect national security and enable scientific discovery. Our expertise in satellites, sensors and instruments, ground systems and data processing, and autonomous systems plays a critical role in missions supporting NASA and the Department of Defense. Join our team of engineers, scientists, technicians, and business professionals in our seventh decade of delivering mission success.

At SDL, we strive to uphold a culture of respect, collaboration, empowerment, and accountability. We listen with open minds, seek to understand diverse perspectives, and engage in thoughtful dialogue. We work together by sharing knowledge, involving others, and offering support. We trust and empower our team members to take ownership, act with integrity, and be accountable. Above all, we deliver on our commitments to each other and to our mission partners.

days; however, it may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. We encourage interested candidates to submit their applications promptly.

jobs.title: Robotics Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Controls Programmer who thrives on solving problems and making machines move.

Position Summary

If you enjoy turning electrical and mechanical concepts into reliable, working automation, this is a role where your contribution will be visible every day. We are seeking a Controls Programmer I to join our team and help program, debug, and commission custom machinery. You will work alongside experienced mechanical and electrical technicians to solve real-world problems, validate machine operation, and make sure each system is ready to perform.

This opportunity is ideal for an early-career controls professional who wants to strengthen their PLC programming skills while gaining meaningful exposure to machine sequencing, electrical systems, operator interfaces, documentation, and field service.

Key Responsibilities

Write and debug PLC code in accordance with work instructions, project specifications, and customer requirements.
Program graphic user interfaces that help operators interact confidently with automated equipment.
Partner with mechanical and electrical technicians to confirm machine sequences and achieve reliable system functionality.
Test switches, cylinders, actuators, and other devices to verify that every component performs as intended.
Maintain accurate project documentation, including drawings, parts lists, calibration data, wire lists, and specifications.
Support machine-manual development and occasional field service work for installation, modification, and system support.
Contribute ideas that improve processes, quality, and the way our team works.

Qualifications

Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related engineering discipline.
A working knowledge of ladder logic programming for a variety of PLC platforms.
Familiarity with PLC networks, communications, and hardware and software interfaces.
Knowledge of foundational electrical concepts, including PNP and NPN switches, AC and DC circuits, E-Stop circuits, and stepper or servo motor function.
The ability to read and understand electrical prints and technical documents.
A safety-first mindset and willingness to work in an active, hands-on environment, including occasional travel when needed.

If you are ready to grow your controls career, work closely with talented technicians, and see your code power real machines, we would love to hear from you. Apply now and help us build automation that performs.

jobs.description:
What We Do

Yesterday's insurance wasn't built for today's risk. We see it in the data and we feel it in the field. Emerging technology can reinvent how risk is priced and managed, faster and smarter, anchored in proven expertise. First-movers will define the next era of commercial risk management, and Shepherd is building it.

Shepherd is a technology-driven Managing General Underwriter (MGU) transforming commercial Property & Casualty insurance for high-hazard industries. Our mission is to make risk frictionless for the builders and operators shaping the physical world, protecting progress from concept through construction and into decades of operation.

We're building the fastest, smartest commercial risk platform, where underwriting expertise, data, and automation work together to deliver:

Faster decisions
Smarter, more accurate pricing
Better risk outcomes

With Shepherd, safety, speed, and quality no longer trade off against one another. They compound. We're not just modernizing insurance products. We're building the risk infrastructure for the next generation of financial services, where technology, underwriting, and partnerships operate in harmony to support the world's most important industries and the progress they make possible.

Our Investors

In March 2026, Shepherd Raised a $42M Series B — Bringing Total Funding To Over $60M — Led By Intact Private Capital, The Investment Arm Of One Of The Largest Insurers In The World. Intact Is Not Only Our Lead Investor But Also a Carrier Partner, a Testament To The Confidence The Incumbent Industry Has In What We're Building. Our Investors

Intact Private Capital, led our Series B round
Costanoa Ventures, led our Series A round
Spark Capital, led our Seed round
Susa Ventures, lead our Pre-Seed round
Y Combinator
And several others

Our Team

We're a team of technologists and insurance enthusiasts, bridging the two worlds together. Check out our About page to learn more.

The Role

We're looking for a talented software engineer who's passionate about what we're building and ready to do the best work of their career. You thrive on ownership, drive results, and care deeply about both technical excellence and customer impact.

You will be the first Engineering team member in NYC, sitting and working closely with our underwriters and actuaries already in NYC.

You would be our dream candidate if...

You aren't afraid of ambiguity, and it may even excite you
You enjoy shipping product every day (maybe multiple times a day) while maintaining high quality standards
You enjoy wearing multiple hats while solving problems; as an engineer, product manager, and designer
You take end-to-end ownership of features and systems, from conception through release
You care about the built-world and how to improve construction safety and productivity
You care about others' growth and welcome mentoring other engineers — you've led or been a major contributor on significant projects
You have strong opinions, weakly held — you advocate for your ideas but adapt when presented with better solutions
You communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
You have some experience with insurance – either from a prior InsurTech role or actuarial role
You have experience working with Javascript/Typescript (backend and/or frontend)
You have at least 8+ years of working experience (preferably as a full-stack engineer) with a track record of delivering high-impact products

About The Role

Shepherd's platform consists of three primary elements: data collection, automated underwriting, and policy administration.

You will lead major initiatives and own a large area of Shepherd's product experience, in each vertical while driving technical decisions for your domain
You will work across the stack, even across different disciplines (e.g. underwriting, design, product management)
You will play an integral role in building our culture as the company grows and mentor other engineers as we scale the team
You will balance innovation with pragmatic delivery — staying current with emerging tech while shipping quality products
You will contribute to product strategy and architectural decisions, not just implementation
You will collaborate closely with PM, Mo (CTO) and the insurance team (underwriters, actuaries and more!)

Our Tech Stack

Typescript
GraphQL w/ Apollo

Backend

Postgres & Redis

GraphQL APIs

How We Work

Shepherd runs on four values. Here's what each one means in this seat.

Think big, build big. We exist to protect progress and the industries that rely on it. The work here is aimed at a system that runs on its own, and the roadmap gets sequenced backward from that rather than forward from what's easy.
Win together. We rise as one. We support each other, raise the bar, and celebrate collective success. As the first PM you set a standard the rest of the team inherits, and the milestones belong to the team rather than to product.
Cross the aisle. Collaboration wins. We listen deeply, work across boundaries, and prioritize shared success over individual lanes. The best product calls here come from engineers who've sat with underwriters and underwriters who understand where the model breaks, and much of this job is listening closely enough on both sides to make that happen.
Go get it. We act with urgency, move with confidence, take smart risks, and push forward with intention. Nobody hands you the roadmap, the data, or the meeting invite. You pull the failing runs, book the time with the underwriters, and decide what matters.

If you enjoy turning electrical and mechanical concepts into reliable, working automation, this is a role where your contribution will be visible every day. You will work alongside experienced mechanical and electrical technicians to solve real-world problems, validate machine operation, and make sure each system is ready to perform.
